title: The State between Death and Resurrection
lead: What happens to a person between death and the resurrection of the body. The Bible speaks of Sheol, of being asleep, of being with Christ, of paradise and of souls under the altar. Churches differ on whether the dead are conscious, whether they are purified, and whether they are with the Lord at once.

sections.b: Jesus tells the thief on the cross, "today you will be with me in paradise" (Luke 23:43). Paul says he would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord (2 Corinthians 5:8) and speaks of departing to be with Christ, which is far better (Philippians 1:23). Elsewhere the dead are said to be asleep (1 Thessalonians 4:13-14). Revelation shows the souls of martyrs under the altar (Revelation 6:9-11).
